name: Shell Shocker
weapon: Awaken. When this material is placed in a weapon that does not deal cold, fire, lightning, necrotic, or thunder damage, it rolls one extra damage die when it hits. For example, a shortsword now rolls 2d6 and a greatsword deals 3d6.

name: Ado.Akantor Spike
armor: Health Boost. While wearing this armor, your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each character level you have.
weapon: Your weapon deals an extra 1d8 fire damage.

name: Uber Plesioth Head
armor: When you take the Dash action while attuned to this armor, you don't provoke opportunity attacks if you moved at least 20 feet in a straight line during the dash.
weapon: (Hammer & Lance Only) You gain a +2 bonus to your attack and damage rolls if you move 20 feet in a straight line towards a creature without taking damage.

name: Chameleos Tail
armor: You have resistance to cold damage while you wear this armor.
weapon: When you cast a spell that deals poison damage or causes the poisoned condition, you can increase your spell attack roll or spell save DC by 2.

name: Chameleos Horn
armor: Rock Steady. While wearing this armor, you can't be unwillingly knocked prone and you ignore effects like the kushala daora and amatsu's wind barrier.
weapon: Critical Status (Poison). Whenever you critically hit with this weapon, the target creature must make a DC 15 Constitution saving throw. On a failed save the target is poisoned for 1 minute.

name: Mizutsune Water Gem
armor: Bubbly+. While attuned to this armor, you have advantage on Dexterity saving throws. Also, the durations from slowing effects, such as the slow spell or a copper dragon's breath attack, are reduced by half.
weapon: (Spellcaster Only) While attuned to this weapon, you know the watery sphere spell. If you prepare spells, you always have it prepared, and it doesn't count against the number of spells you can prepare each day. If this spell is not on your class list, the spell is nonetheless a class spell for you.

name: Teostra Mane
armor: (Paladin Only) You can use an action to speak this armor's command word to extend your aura by 5 feet for 1 minute. Once you use this property, you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.
weapon: Critical Eye. Your weapon attacks critical hit range is increased by 1.

name: J.Barroth Gem
armor: (Sorcerer, Warlock, & Wizard only) This armor has two runes that it regains daily at dawn. As an action you can expend one of these runes to cast armor of agathys at 3rd level.
weapon: (Hammer only) While attuned to this weapon, your hammer's charge only requires you to move 10 feet in a straight line instead of 20 feet.
